stops.name: Val di Tovel
stops.detail: He proposes to establish a protected area only in the Val di Tovel, his hope being that as it was a small patch of land, between 5,000 and 10,000 hectares, devoid of housing, the bureaucratic complications should be minor and instead, once again, inertia won out.

stops.name: Dolomiti di Brenta
stops.detail: It extends into western Trentino between the Val di Non, the Giudicarie and the Val di Sole, over a territory of more than 620 square kilometers, which includes the mountain groups of Adamello-Presanella (where one of the largest European glaciers is located) and the Brenta Dolomites.
